## Summary

Describe the user or reviewer problem and the smallest coherent change made.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` when a user/reviewer flow changed

## Evidence

Add screenshots, test output, migration notes, or validator evidence as appropriate.

## Content, privacy, and security

- [ ] No secrets, personal learner data, protected exam content, or unsupported claims are included.
- [ ] New educational content has provenance, deterministic checks where possible, and a review path.
- [ ] Authorization, data-retention, webhook, prediction, or billing risks are explained and tested when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` reflect contract or configuration changes.

## Known limitations and follow-up

List anything intentionally deferred. Use `None` when there is no known follow-up.
